tools.name: list_places
tools.description: Andrew's curated places in Chelsea, optionally filtered by category, use-case tag or featured picks. Each result links to its https://knowchelsea.com/place/{slug} page; ranked pages live at https://knowchelsea.com/best/{category}.

tools.name: get_place
tools.description: Full editorial record for one Chelsea place by slug, including Andrew's description and the public /place URL.

tools.name: nearby_places
tools.description: Nearest curated Chelsea places to a WGS84 coordinate supplied in the request, with distance in metres.
